name: en-blog-cookies-only
text:
Cookies and privacy

This blog uses cookies to remember your preferences and to measure traffic with Google Analytics.

You can disable cookies in your browser at any time.

If you leave a comment, your name and email are stored with the comment so that it can be shown.

Questions? Use the contact form.
reasoning: A blog whose privacy page is really a cookie notice, read under Danish law. No controller is named. Purposes and recipients are alluded to without a basis or a name, so both are undetermined. The other nine elements are not there. Mostly absences, with two elements too vague to count either way.
